annotations: Annotation(<http://purl.org/dc/terms/description> "Chemical Entities of Biological Interest, also known as ChEBI, is a chemical database and ontology of molecular entities focused on 'small' chemical compounds, that is part of the Open Biomedical Ontologies (OBO) effort at the European Bioinformatics Institute (EBI).")

Annotation(rdfs:comment "ChEBI subsumes and replaces the Chemical Ontology first. This ontology was developed by Michael Ashburner and Pankaj Jaiswal. Data was cuarated by The ChEBI Curation Team. For any queries contact chebi-help@ebi.ac.uk")
